description: This Java class defines a provider for the connectivity service that specifically handles signal enrichment using a round-trip approach. It instantiates and provides access to a facade that manages communication with an actor system for signal enrichment operations.

classes.name: ConnectivityByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: A final class extending ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider, responsible for creating and providing a signal enrichment facade that performs round-trip signal enrichment by communicating with an actor system.

methods.name: ConnectivityByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider by creating an actor selection and configuring the signal enrichment facade based on provided configuration.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Returns the signal enrichment facade instance to be used for a specific connection ID; in this case, it always returns the same facade instance.

methods.name: getByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentFacade
methods.description: Package-private getter for accessing the singleton signal enrichment facade associated with this provider instance.
